# E2E DXF Fixture Sources

DXF files in this directory are downloaded from public GitHub repositories
for end-to-end testing. They are `.gitignore`d and not committed.

Run `bash scripts/download_e2e_fixtures.sh` to fetch them.

## Sources

| Local Name | Repository | License | Path |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jscad-texts.dxf` | [jscad/sample-files](https://github.com/jscad/sample-files) | MIT | `dxf/dxf-parser/texts.dxf` |
| `jscad-blocks1.dxf` | [jscad/sample-files](https://github.com/jscad/sample-files) | MIT | `dxf/dxf-parser/blocks1.dxf` |
| `jscad-blocks2.dxf` | [jscad/sample-files](https://github.com/jscad/sample-files) | MIT | `dxf/dxf-parser/blocks2.dxf` |
| `jscad-floorplan.dxf` | [jscad/sample-files](https://github.com/jscad/sample-files) | MIT | `dxf/dxf-parser/floorplan.dxf` |
| `jscad-CustomBlocks.dxf` | [jscad/sample-files](https://github.com/jscad/sample-files) | MIT | `dxf/ezdxf/CustomBlocks.dxf` |
| `gds-mtext-test.dxf` | [gdsestimating/dxf-parser](https://github.com/gdsestimating/dxf-parser) | MIT | `test/data/mtext-test.dxf` |
